# Creative Metal Industries

> Industrial metal supplier based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Product and specification information on this website is provided for enquiries; confirm exact scope, availability, documentation and terms for each order.

## About

Creative Metal Industries is presented on this website as a Vadodara-based industrial metal supplier. Product categories and technical details below are enquiry references, not guarantees of current offering or stock. Confirm each requirement with the company before purchase.

- Company establishment date: confirm with company records before publication

## Products

- Stainless Steel Pipes and Tubes (ASTM A312, A213, A269) — SS 304, 304L, 316, 316L, 317L, 321, 310S, 347, 904L
- Duplex and Super Duplex Steel (ASTM A790, A240) — UNS S31803, S32750, S32205
- Alloy steel pipe enquiry references — confirm grade, specification, applicable documentation and order scope
- Carbon Steel Pipes and Plates (ASTM A106, SA 516, IS 2062, API 5L)
- SS Buttweld Fittings (ASTM A403, A815) — Elbows, Tees, Reducers, ASME B16.9
- Forged Fittings and Flanges (ASTM A182, A105) — ASME B16.5, B16.11
- Plates, Sheets and Coils — SS, CS, Alloy, Hardox, Clad, Corten
- Structural Steel — MS Angles, Channels, Beams, Bars, TMT (IS 2062, IS 808, IS 1786)
- Exotic Alloys — Inconel 600/625/718, Monel 400, Hastelloy C-276/C-22, Titanium Gr.1/2/5
